```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, dpi=300, fig.width=8, fig.height=6)
if(!require("haven")) {install.packages("haven"); library("haven")}
if(!require("ggplot2")) {install.packages("ggplot2"); library("ggplot2")}
if(!require("dplyr")) {install.packages("dplyr"); library("dplyr")}
if(!require("reshape2")) {install.packages("reshape2"); library("reshape2")}
if(!require("wesanderson")) {install.packages("wesanderson"); library("wesanderson")}
```

```{r include=FALSE}
nigeria <- read_sav("afrobarometer_release-data_nig_r8_en_2021-03-31.sav", encoding = "latin1")
```

## Questions  {.tabset}

### Q2.Language spoken in home
What is the primary language you speak in your home now?

```{r include=FALSE}
q2 <- subset(nigeria, select=c("RESPNO","Q2", "withinwt_hh", "URBRUR", "Q97", "Q113", "Q95C"))
#recode the answer
q2$Q2[as.numeric(q2$Q2) == "-1"] <- NA

q2 <- na.omit(q2)

```

```{r Plot 1A, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cname <- c("English", "Hausa", "Igbo", "Yoruba", "Pidgin English", "Efik", "Ebira", "Fulani", "Isoko", "Ibibio", "Kanuri", "Tiv", "Nupe", "Ijaw", "Edo", "Igala", "Urhobo", "Ogoni", "Anang", "Ikwere", "Idoma", "Esan", "Karekare", "Berom", "Agatu", "Other", "Refused", "Don't know")
p <- q2 %>%
  group_by(Q2) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(withinwt_hh)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Q2), y = value)) + 
      geom_col(fill="blue", color="black") +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = cname)+
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = c(0,5))+
      labs(title = "Language spoken in home",
           y = "Density",
           x= "") + 
      theme_bw() +
      theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray"))
p
```


#### Urban and Rural
```{r Plot 1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cname <- c("English", "Hausa", "Igbo", "Yoruba", "Pidgin English", "Efik", "Ebira", "Fulani", "Isoko", "Ibibio", "Kanuri", "Tiv", "Nupe", "Ijaw", "Edo", "Igala", "Urhobo", "Ogoni", "Anang", "Ikwere", "Idoma", "Esan", "Karekare", "Berom", "Agatu", "Other", "Refused", "Don't know")
p <- q2 %>%
  group_by(Q2) %>%
  summarise(urban = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(URBRUR) == "1" ]),
            rural = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(URBRUR) == "2" ])) %>%
  melt(id.vars='Q2') %>%
  group_by(Q2) %>% 
    mutate(ratio = value/sum(value),
           ratio = scales::percent(ratio, accuracy = 1),
           ratio = ifelse(ratio == "0%", NA, ratio )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Q2), y = value, fill = variable)) + 
      geom_col(stat='identity', position="fill") +
      geom_text(aes(label=ratio),size=2, position=position_fill(vjust=0.5)) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = cname)+
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = c(0,0,0.05,0))+
      labs(title = "Language spoken in home (Urban and Rural)",
           y = "Density",
           x= "") + 
      theme_bw() +
      theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray"))
p
```

#### Education
```{r Plot 1.1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cname <- c("English", "Hausa", "Igbo", "Yoruba", "Pidgin English", "Efik", "Ebira", "Fulani", "Isoko", "Ibibio", "Kanuri", "Tiv", "Nupe", "Ijaw", "Edo", "Igala", "Urhobo", "Ogoni", "Anang", "Ikwere", "Idoma", "Esan", "Karekare", "Berom", "Agatu", "Other", "Refused", "Don't know")
color <- c( "#C4961A", "#999999","#FFDB6D","orange","coral1","#D16103","#00AFBB", "#C3D7A4", "#52854C",  "#F4EDCA", "#4E84C4")

p <- q2 %>%
  group_by(Q2) %>%
  summarise(no_schooling = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "0" ]),
            informal_only = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "1" ]),
            some_primary = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "2"]),
            primary_completed = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "3"]),
            some_secondary = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "4"]),
            secondary_completed = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "5"]),
            post_secondary = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "6"]),
            some_university = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "7"]),
            university_completed = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "8"]),
            post_graduate = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "9"]),
            unknow = sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "99"]) + 
                     sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "-1"]) +
                     sum(withinwt_hh[as.numeric(Q97) == "98"])
            ) %>%
  melt(id.vars='Q2') %>%
  group_by(Q2) %>% 
    mutate(ratio = value/sum(value),
           ratio = scales::percent(ratio, accuracy = 1),
           ratio = ifelse(ratio == "0%", NA, ratio )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Q2), y = value, fill = variable)) + 
      geom_col(stat='identity', position="fill") +
      geom_text(aes(label=ratio),size=2, position=position_fill(vjust=0.5)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = color) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = cname)+
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = c(0,0,0.05,0))+
      labs(title = "Language spoken in home (Education)",
           y = "Density",
           x= "") + 
      theme_bw() +
      theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray"))
p
```

### Q39a. Tax authorities have right to enforce taxes
For each of the following statements, please tell me whether you disagree or agree: The tax authorities always have the right to make people pay taxes.
```{r include=FALSE}
q39a <- subset(nigeria, select=c("RESPNO","Q39A","withinwt_hh", "URBRUR", "Q97", "Q113", "Q95C"))
#recode the answer
q39a$Q39A[as.numeric(q39a$Q39A) == "-1"] <- NA
q39a <- na.omit(q39a)
```

```{r Plot 2A, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cname <- c("Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neither agree\nnor disagree", "Agree", "Strongly agree", "Don’t know")
p <- q39a %>%
  group_by(Q39A) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(withinwt_hh)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Q39A), y = value)) + 
      geom_col(fill="blue", color="black") +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = (cname))+
      scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,5))+
      labs(title = "Tax authorities have right to enforce taxes",
           y = "Density",
           x= "") + 
      theme_bw() +
      theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray"))
p
```

### Q41j. The tax/revenue office

```{r include=FALSE}
q41j <- subset(nigeria, select=c("RESPNO","Q41J", "withinwt_hh", "URBRUR", "Q97", "Q113", "Q95C"))
#recode the answer

q41j <- na.omit(q41j)
```


```{r Plot 3A, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

  group_by(Q41J) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(withinwt_hh)) %>%
  melt(id.vars='Q41J') %>%

      geom_col(fill="blue", color="black") +

           x= "") +
```

### Q48 Most important problems
In your opinion, what are the most important problems facing this country that government should address?
```{r}
q48 <- subset(nigeria, select = c("RESPNO","Q48PT1","Q48PT2", "Q48PT3","withinwt_hh")) %>%
  mutate(a = ifelse(as.numeric(Q48PT1) == 24, 1, 0),
         b = ifelse(as.numeric(Q48PT2) == 24, 1, 0),
         c = ifelse(as.numeric(Q48PT3) == 24, 1, 0))
         
q48a <- q48 %>%
  group_by(a) %>%
  summarise(number = sum(withinwt_hh)) %>%
  mutate(perc = `number` / sum(`number`)) %>% 
  arrange(perc) %>%
  mutate(labels = scales::percent(perc))
 
q48b <- q48 %>%
  group_by(b) %>%
  summarise(number = sum(withinwt_hh)) %>%
  mutate(perc = `number` / sum(`number`)) %>% 
  arrange(perc) %>%
  mutate(labels = scales::percent(perc)) 

q48c <- q48 %>%
  group_by(c) %>%
  summarise(number = sum(withinwt_hh)) %>%
  mutate(perc = `number` / sum(`number`)) %>% 
  arrange(perc) %>%
  mutate(labels = scales::percent(perc)) 
```

### Q85. More that unites or more that divides people
Nigerians are very diverse. They come from different religions, ethnic groups, political parties, and economic and social backgrounds. Overall, would you say that there is more that unites all Nigerians as one people, or more that divides them?
```{r include=FALSE}
q85 <- subset(nigeria, select=c("RESPNO","Q85", "withinwt_hh","URBRUR", "Q97", "Q113", "Q95C"))
#recode the answer
q85$Q85[as.numeric(q85$Q85) == "-1"] <- NA

q85 <- na.omit(q85)
```

```{r Plot 25A, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cname <- c("Much more \nthat divides us", "Somewhat more \nthat divides us", "Somewhat more \nthat unites us", "Much more \nthat \nunites us","Refused", "Don’t know")
p <- q85 %>%
  group_by(Q85) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(withinwt_hh)) %>%
  melt(id.vars='Q85') %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Q85), y = value)) + 
      geom_col(fill="blue", color="black") +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = (cname))+
      scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,5))+
      labs(title = "More that unites or more that divides people",
           y = "Density",
           x= "") + 
      theme_bw() +
      theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray"))
p
```

## Media Questions   {.tabset}
### Q55 A-E {.tabset}
Now let us talk about the media and how you get information about politics and other issues. How often do you get news from the following sources?
```{r include=FALSE}

q55$Q55A[as.numeric(q55$Q55A) == "-1"] <- NA
q55$Q55B[as.numeric(q55$Q55B) == "-1"] <- NA
q55$Q55C[as.numeric(q55$Q55C) == "-1"] <- NA
q55$Q55D[as.numeric(q55$Q55D) == "-1"] <- NA
q55$Q55E[as.numeric(q55$Q55E) == "-1"] <- NA

q55 <- na.omit(q55)
```
